styleHint.relax: Slow days, spa, beach or pool time, few early starts.
styleHint.adventure: Hiking, diving, kayaking and other active outdoor plans.
styleHint.culture: Temples, museums, old towns and local traditions.
styleHint.food: Street food, markets, local specialties and well-known restaurants.
styleHint.nature: Mountains, lakes, national parks and viewpoints.
styleHint.nightlife: Bars, night markets, live music and evening shows.
styleHint.shopping: Malls, markets, local crafts and souvenirs.
styleHint.luxury: Upscale hotels, fine dining and private transfers.

errors.invalid_request: Some details are not valid. Check them and send again.
errors.not_found: This was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: This plan changed, here is the latest version.
errors.card_closed: This was already used in another tab. The chat now shows the latest state.

errors.payload_too_large: That is too long to send. Shorten it and try again.
